messages.subject: shinyapps deployment error
parts:
I was having trouble renaming my deployed shinyApp - renaming the root app folder on my local machine did not work as deployApp() would keep updating the app with the previous name. I thentried something that was suggested on our course forum which is to delete the shinyapps subdir under the app folder and then deploy it. Now I get deployment errors about too many links. Here's the console output:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 48068...
Waiting for task: 45633369
  building: Processing bundle: 208319
  building: Parsing manifest
  error: Installing packages
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 45633370 error: Unhandled Exception: mkdir /mnt/docker/volumes/9afc157f131f338daa23af3b9d2b76bea6c2960ff0675ae5cce693d046291502: too many links

I tried archiving my app and deleting it from the shinyapps.io server so that I could start with a clean slate but nothing seems to work any more. Keep getting this error and I have a deadline that is 12 hours away at this point! HELP!

messages.author: b7f2b55eee0de402
messages.subject: Re: shinyapps deployment error
parts: Tried deploying again and it worked the second time! Seems to be a server side error. To the Coursera students who have reported the same issue I would suggest you keep retrying the deployApp() function until you succeed. Good luck!
